semantics: Fixture set for the #42 shadow-mode semantic-review benchmark. Non-canonical. Every fixture is derived from data already committed to this repository (data/reference/topic-evidence.json and data/staging/topic-evidence-reviews.json + topic-evidence-drafts.json). No fixture content is invented. This file is never written by automation and never feeds canonical promotion.
coverage_gaps: All 22 canonical-derived fixtures are scope=federal; no estadual example exists among verified canonical entries.
No committed fixture has evidence_type=declaracao; only proposta and atuacao are represented.

No committed fixture represents a true reject-class case with full source text (the 154-row wartime curation ledger records REJEITAR/QUARENTENA only as draft_id labels, without the underlying draft text, because most of those 5.959 drafts were never promoted from the automated worker's run-scoped CI artifact into git).

No committed fixture demonstrates homonym collision, PDF document_type, or multi-candidate source conflict; these categories from the issue's heterogeneity list are not yet testable from git-tracked data alone.
quote_or_summary is an empty string on all 22 canonical entries; classifier input for those fixtures falls back to statement only.
